items.name: Leutenegger/vanity-eth
items.full_text: Offline vanity address generator for Bitcoin and Ethereum. CPU multi-process search with interactive CLI menu. Supports Legacy, Nested SegWit, Native SegWit, Taproot, and ETH (EIP-55).

items.name: Leutenegger/claudish-to-english
items.full_text: Claude Code plugin that rewrites each assistant message into plain language on screen only. Local ollama by default; also codex CLI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible API. Fail-open. Optional Markdown rewrite.

items.name: MengTo/threeui
items.full_text: Open-source ThreeUI Community catalog with live interactive components and complete Community source.
